beats.caption: This is Component 4 — every concept you will meet, drawn in its place.
Everything starts at a microphone — capture decides what you have to mix later.
Signals flow: mic level becomes line level, and good gain keeps noise below the music.
At the converter, sound becomes numbers — sample rate and bit depth set the limits.
Inside the DAW, audio and MIDI live side by side — one is sound, one is instructions.
Synthesis builds sound from nothing; sampling borrows it — both feed your productions.
Editing, correction and automation shape a take into a performance.
The processors — EQ, compression, and the time-based effects — do the mixing work.
Nothing lives alone: the filter you met in synthesis is the EQ you mix with.
Compression is a levels decision — squeeze dynamics and the average level can rise.
Everything converges on the mix: balance it, place it in stereo, master it, trust your monitors.
One subject, one map. Every lesson from here is a journey across it.
